source_backed_findings: Investigation truth/solution must remain distinct from Player hypotheses and claims.
Clues may be objects, testimony, environmental observations, hidden messages or digital information.
Discovery and analysis are distinct stages and analysis may expose significance, inconsistencies or further clues.
Red herrings, false evidence, unreliable witnesses and corrupted information are supported mystery elements.
Witness statements, contradictions and reliability are first-class concerns.
Typed temporal reasoning and Investigation timeline views are supported.
Important information should have redundant discovery paths; direct source recommends at least two placements for important information.
Dynamic/extra clues may be used to recover stalled progress with attributable delivery conditions.
Surface, hidden and revealed/core-truth layers are direct source concepts.
Mystery construction uses core event, actor/culprit, motive, twist, setting, clues, NPCs, locations, complications and resolution components.
Player-facing dossier material and GM truth/solution material are distinct projections.
Research, archives and Knowledge can discover/correlate information but do not bypass permissions or define canonical truth by themselves.
Cross-case correlation and historical records are supported.
Provenance is required for clues, connections and evidence.
explicit_source_gaps: No single deterministic objective-truth statement/version schema is supplied by source.
No normalized universal confidence/relevance/authenticity/source-reliability scale is supplied across all clue types.
No deterministic mystery-solvability algorithm is supplied.
No machine-checkable universal clue-redundancy or reachability rule is supplied beyond source guidance.
No formal contradiction taxonomy/resolution workflow is supplied.
No universal fairness threshold for red herrings/false leads is supplied.
No universal required-versus-optional revelation schema is supplied.
No universal minimum clue count or success/failure consequence formula is supplied.
Investigation/Knowledge abilities do not automatically become clue truth or authoring schema.
World timeline facts do not automatically become Player-known Investigation facts.
